title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
summary: A gifted six-year-old is taken to an orbiting military school to be trained as humanity's commander against an alien enemy. The games and pressure become harder and lonelier at every step.
readIf: you like smart, tense stories about a young prodigy under pressure and the ethics of using children in war.
skipIf: you dislike stories where children face bullying and brutal violence, which are central here.

pairings.reason: Another story of young people trained and used by adults for a battle that is also a spectacle.
A different and much more militaristic look at the same questions of training, duty and war.
A brutal, high-stakes school of rivals where a gifted outsider learns to lead.
